text:
Adam Lowry is the Jets' captain, and after a 7-0 loss in Carolina on Nov. 1 that stretched the skid to nine, he said, per The Hockey News headline, "There's Gonna Be Changes." Two wins have followed, a comeback in Montreal and a 6-2 win over Vancouver. NHL.com also ran a story on his unusual route to a milestone assist.

His own game hasn't changed much. He has 6 points in 17 games, 36 hits, and finishing right on schedule (2 goals on 2.2 expected). The Jets take 44% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice at five on five, about four points worse than without him, and Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level last season.

What Lowry gives Winnipeg doesn't show up well in those numbers: 855 games with one franchise, the matchup minutes and the voice in the room. That's opinion, but it's why he wears the C. He's 33, a 2011 third-round pick who came up through Swift Current. We project about 10 goals. Sunday's game against a Tampa team that has been rolling is the next test of whether the changes are real.
headline: Lowry said there would be changes
